# Plain Metal's generateMipmapsForTexture: of BGR10_XR and BGRA10_XR on an Apple M3 Max (macOS 26.7)
# and an Apple M4 (macOS 27.0.1), the first computed level of share-mips-m3d's random textures
# (193x193, 513x513, 1025x1025; our own probe). Each row is one field's sum (BGRA10_XR's fields are
# its four lanes, the fourth alpha): on each GPU every term (a code times its weight) is floored
# before the sum, a colour's to 2^-13 code and alpha's to 2^-15, and the rows are a sample of the
# sums where that floor and the exact sum give different codes, with near-tie sums where they agree.
# Format:
#   <m3|m4> <format> <width>x<height> <x> <y> <field> <tap codes: (x0, y0) (x1, y0) (x0, y1)
#   (x1, y1)> <the measured code>
